title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
summary: 基于MedNeXt的乳腺DCE-MRI分割在多队列中评估测量保真度，含外部验证与放射科医生审阅。
key_points: 肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%，ICC 0.97
内部Dice 0.831，DUKE留出层0.823

reason: 回顾性但含独立外部验证并以测量保真度为终点，属重要档
abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.
zh_abstract: 自动乳腺动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）分割可促进肿瘤定量测量，但仅凭几何重叠并不能确立掩膜衍生测量的保真度。我们开发了一个增强感知的三维 MedNeXt 框架，具有门控跳跃融合和边界监督，并在回顾性多队列设计中评估它，涵盖锁定的内部测试、源数据留出评估、回顾性外部验证和放射科医师审阅。测量保真度是主要终点。在 521 对配对的内部测试和 DUKE 病例中，肿瘤体积的中位误差为 9.7%，三维最大表面直径为 1.8 mm，操作性增强定义体积为 10.2%，相应 ICC 分别为 0.97、0.80 和 0.97。中位 Dice 在内部为 0.831，在 DUKE 源数据留出分层中为 0.823，在 BC-MRI-SEG 和公开 BreastDCEDL_AMBL 回顾性外部验证队列中分别为 0.812 和 0.806，使用冻结检查点且未进行外部标签调优。在盲法双读者审阅中，80 个掩膜中有 78 个无需重大修正。在 276 个配对反应分析病例中，自动几何的 AUROC 为 0.732，专家几何为 0.757（差异，−0.025；95% CI，−0.095 至 0.045）；未证明判别非劣效性。这些发现支持自动分割作为在评估队列内由放射科医师监督的回顾性定量研究的起点，同时将测量保真度与下游预测等效性区分开来。

title: Beyond skin deep: physiologic oral pigmentation as an overlooked validation gap in AI-assisted oral cancer screening

abstract: AI-assisted oral cancer screening tools, exemplified by MeMoSA, have been validated almost exclusively in Asian populations. We propose a testable hypothesis: physiologic oral pigmentation, which varies by race independent of pathology, may cause classifiers to misclassify normal variation as suspicious or miss camouflaged lesions. Following precedent from pulse oximetry and dermatology AI, we call for pigmentation-stratified validation before deployment in racially diverse settings such as the United States.
zh_abstract: 以MeMoSA为例的AI辅助口腔癌筛查工具几乎仅在亚洲人群中得到验证。我们提出一个可检验的假说：生理性口腔色素沉着随种族而变化且与病理无关，可能使分类器将正常变异误判为可疑，或漏诊被掩盖的病变。参照脉搏血氧测定和皮肤病学AI的先例，我们呼吁在种族多样化环境（如美国）部署前进行按色素沉着分层的验证。

title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
zh_title: 学习型健康系统框架与AI整合：范围综述
summary: 范围综述梳理美国54项LHS框架研究与30项AI/数据科学研究，归纳五大共性组件并考察二者整合方式。
key_points: 纳入54项框架研究，其中30项为真实落地
另纳入30项AI与数据科学研究
归纳数据基础设施、治理、学习循环等五组件
reason: 范围综述，信息有组织但无新方法或结局数据，属值得一看档
abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
zh_abstract: 学习型卫生系统（LHSs）利用常规收集的数据生成证据，通过持续学习循环为实践提供信息。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但LHS框架与AI应用之间的关系仍不明确。我们梳理了LHS框架及其组成部分，并考察了AI和数据科学如何被整合。检索识别出2007年1月至2025年8月发表的美国开展的英文研究；两名评审员独立筛选并提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入54项框架研究（24项[44%]为概念性改编；30项[56%]为真实世界实施）和30项AI/数据科学研究。框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化，以及公平与伦理。相对于框架研究，AI研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% vs 35%）或公平（13% vs 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数AI研究（27/30）聚焦于数据到知识阶段；仅三项扩展到知识到实践，且无一描述实践到数据的反馈，即以部署后结局指导模型更新。AI应用仅涵盖LHS愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，而较少关注将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织与反馈机制。

title: Challenges of Single-Reference Benchmarks for Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model-Based Decision Support.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: 单参考基准评估大模型临床推理的局限
summary: JMIR观点文章讨论以单一参考决策一致性评估大模型临床决策支持的局限，主张补充以推理为中心的评估。
key_points: 多领域基准仍主要依赖与参考决策的一致性
复杂或偏好敏感决策中一致性评估不足
以肿瘤为例，决策差异属结构性特征而非噪声
reason: 方法学观点述评，切中基准评估痛点，但属观点类上限档
abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] This viewpoint addresses developers and evaluators of large language model (LLM)-based clinical decision support systems. Although recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate multiple clinical reasoning domains, many still rely substantially on reference decision agreement-whether model outputs conform to predefined decisions. Our aim is to clarify when such agreement remains useful, when it becomes insufficient for complex or preference-sensitive decisions, and how it can be complemented by reasoning-centered assessment. Clinical decision-making often depends on structured reasoning under uncertainty, integrating probabilistic evidence, contextual constraints, and patient values. Using oncology as an illustrative domain, we argue that some decision variability is a structural feature of clinical reasoning rather than noise or error. Used alone in such settings, single-reference benchmarks may conflate reasonable divergence with incorrectness and reward answer imitation over transparent reasoning. We conclude that reference decision agreement should be retained for tasks with stable ground truth but supplemented by evidence grounding, reasoning quality, patient-centeredness, and safety checks for open-ended clinical decision support. This multidimensional approach is intended to support safer and more clinically meaningful evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 本观点文章面向基于大语言模型（large language model, LLM）的临床决策支持系统的开发者和评估者。尽管近期基准测试越来越多地评估多个临床推理领域，但许多仍主要依赖参考决策一致性——即模型输出是否符合预先定义的决策。我们的目标是阐明这种一致性在何时仍然有用、在何时对复杂或偏好敏感的决策变得不足，以及如何通过以推理为中心的评估加以补充。临床决策常依赖不确定性下的结构化推理，整合概率性证据、情境约束和患者价值观。以肿瘤学作为示例领域，我们认为某些决策变异性是临床推理的结构性特征，而非噪声或错误。在此类情境中单独使用时，单参考基准可能将合理分歧与不正确混为一谈，并奖励答案模仿而非透明推理。我们得出结论：对于真实标签稳定的任务，应保留参考决策一致性，但对于开放式临床决策支持，应辅以证据落地、推理质量、以患者为中心以及安全性检查。这种多维方法旨在支持更安全且更具临床意义的评估。

title: Toward Clinically Trustworthy Deep Learning in Cardiology: A Unified Mathematical Synthesis of Representation, Optimization, and Reliability.
zh_title: 心脏病学可信深度学习的数学综合
summary: 该系统综述基于PRISMA分析79篇文献，提出心脏病学可信深度学习在表示、优化与可靠性上的统一数学视角。
key_points: 纳入2017–2025年79篇同行评审文献
指出预测准确率与临床可靠性存在明显差距
聚焦不确定性、鲁棒性、公平性与可解释性
reason: PRISMA系统综述纳入79篇，规范但无原始数据，按综述档给6分
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Deep learning (DL) has revolutionized cardiovascular medicine by allowing for automated analysis of electrocardiography, imaging of the heart, and multimodal clinical datasets. Although there have been impressive advancements in terms of predictive performance, the deployment of DL methods in a clinical setting remains limited due to lack of sufficient mathematical understanding around the concepts of uncertainty, robustness, fairness, explainability, and generalizability. Methods: In this work, a systematic review is conducted using PRISMA principles on 79 peer-reviewed articles published from 2017 until 2025, with a unifying mathematical perspective on the notion of trustworthy deep learning in cardiology. Results: We find that there is significant discrepancy between prediction accuracy and clinical reliability, with little emphasis placed on mathematical guarantees, reproducibility of evaluation procedures, calibration, or robustness verification. To address this challenge, we propose a conceptual mathematical framework which brings together the elements of representation learning, optimization, and trustworthiness into a unified audit of AI in cardiac care. We note that the presented indices are purely theoretical and are meant to provide guidance for future standardization, and as such do not represent actual clinical metrics. Conclusions: Although our paper does not propose any new predictive algorithms, we do contribute a strong theoretical basis for the evaluation and development of clinically reliable deep learning algorithms in cardiology.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】深度学习（DL）通过实现心电图、心脏影像和多模态临床数据集的自动化分析，已使心血管医学发生革命性变化。尽管在预测性能方面已有令人瞩目的进展，但由于围绕不确定性、稳健性、公平性、可解释性和泛化性等概念缺乏充分的数学理解，DL方法在临床环境中的部署仍然有限。【方法】在本工作中，依据PRISMA原则对2017年至2025年发表的79篇同行评议文章进行了系统综述，并以统一的数学视角审视心脏病学中可信深度学习的概念。【结果】我们发现预测准确性与临床可靠性之间存在显著差异，对数学保证、评估流程的可重复性、校准或稳健性验证的强调很少。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个概念性数学框架，将表示学习、优化和可信性等要素整合到对心脏护理中AI的统一审计中。我们指出，所提出的指标纯属理论性质，旨在为未来标准化提供指导，因此并不代表实际临床指标。【结论】尽管我们的论文没有提出任何新的预测算法，但我们确实为心脏病学中临床可靠深度学习算法的评估和开发提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: An Interpretable Multimodal Deep Learning Framework Integrating MRI and Clinical Data via Bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention for Improved Cardiac Disease Detection.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 融合MRI与临床数据的可解释多模态心脏病变检测
summary: 提出双向跨模态注意力框架，联合心脏MRI与结构化临床变量进行可解释心脏病检测。
key_points: 双向跨模态注意力对齐影像与临床特征
ResNet-50与多层感知机双编码器

reason: 同行评审的方法类研究，有新意但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Cardiovascular diseases continue to be the primary cause of mortality worldwide; however, precise diagnosis is often limited by dependence on individual data modalities and the unclear nature of traditional deep learning models. In this study, we introduce an explainable multimodal deep learning framework that simultaneously analyzes cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and structured clinical variables through a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism that operates on token sequences. The architecture utilizes modality-specific encoders ResNet-50 for imaging and a multilayer perceptron for clinical data interconnected through attention that dynamically aligns complementary information, reducing feature dilution and modal dominance. A multitask objective that includes classification, contrastive alignment (InfoNCE), and regularization further reinforces semantic consistency across modalities. Integrated post hoc explainability modules, such as Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping for spatial localization and SHapley Additive exPlanations for clinical feature attribution, offer transparent decision support. Tested on a cohort of 12,847 patients using fivefold cross-validation, the framework achieved an accuracy of 94.2% and an area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve of 0.97, significantly surpassing unimodal and traditional multimodal baselines (p < 0.01). The explanations generated showed 91% concordance with independent cardiologist evaluations. The findings presented herein were derived through internal five-fold cross-validation conducted at a solitary tertiary care institution, thereby substantiating internal validity while limiting multicenter generalizability; consequently, external validation is requisite for broader applicability. These results demonstrate that attention-driven multimodal fusion, combined with post hoc explainability, provides both strong diagnostic performance and clinically useful transparency, positioning the framework as a promising internally validated approach and a foundation for future external validation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 心血管疾病仍然是全球死亡的主要原因；然而，精确诊断往往受限于对单一数据模态的依赖以及传统深度学习模型的不透明性。在本研究中，我们引入了一个可解释的多模态深度学习框架，该框架通过作用于 token 序列的双向跨模态注意力机制，同时分析心脏磁共振成像（MRI）和结构化临床变量。该架构利用模态特异性编码器——用于影像的 ResNet-50 和用于临床数据的多层感知机——通过注意力相互连接，动态对齐互补信息，减少特征稀释和模态主导。包含分类、对比对齐（InfoNCE）和正则化的多任务目标进一步强化跨模态的语义一致性。集成的事后可解释性模块，例如用于空间定位的梯度加权类激活映射和用于临床特征归因的 SHapley Additive exPlanations，提供透明的决策支持。在一个 12,847 名患者的队列上使用五折交叉验证进行测试，该框架达到了 94.2% 的准确率和 0.97 的受试者工作特征曲线下面积，显著优于单模态和传统多模态基线（p < 0.01）。生成的解释与独立心脏病专家评估的一致性为 91%。本文呈现的发现来自在一家单一三级医疗中心进行的内部五折交叉验证，从而证实了内部有效性，但限制了多中心泛化性；因此，需要外部验证才能实现更广泛的适用性。这些结果表明，注意力驱动的多模态融合结合事后可解释性，既提供了强大的诊断性能，也提供了临床上有用的透明度，使该框架成为一种有前景的经内部验证的方法，并为未来的外部验证奠定基础。

title: MRI-derived synthetic [¹⁸F]FET PET in neuro-oncology: evaluation in glioma grading and differentiation from solitary brain metastasis.

summary: 回顾性分析 489 例患者，用深度学习由多模态 MRI 生成合成 FET PET，并评估其分级与鉴别效能。
key_points: 回顾性纳入 489 例组织学确诊胶质瘤或脑转移患者

abstract: [Neuroradiology] O-(2-[18F]fluoroethyl)-L-tyrosine positron emission tomography ([18F]FET PET) is clinically useful in neuro-oncology but limited by cost and availability. We assessed the clinical utility of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived synthetic [18F]FET PET. A total of 489 patients with histologically confirmed gliomas or brain metastases were retrospectively analyzed. A deep learning model generated synthetic PET images from multimodal MRI in the overall cohort and subgroups. Synthetic PET was evaluated against reference PET for image similarity by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) analysis by Pearson correlation and Bland-Altman analysis, and blinded reader assessment for glioma grading and high-grade glioma (HGG) versus solitary brain metastasis (SBM) differentiation using receiver operating characteristic analysis with area under the curve (AUC). Synthetic PET showed high similarity to reference PET in the overall, glioma, and metastasis groups (PSNR, 34.7-35.5 dB; SSIM, 0.90-0.96), and SUVR correlations were strong (r = 0.77-0.93, all P 0.05). MRI-derived synthetic [18F]FET PET may enhance glioma grading and HGG-SBM differentiation, providing a PET-like alternative when FET PET is unavailable.
zh_abstract: [Neuroradiology] O-(2-[18F]氟乙基)-L-酪氨酸正电子发射断层显像（[18F]FET PET）在神经肿瘤学中具有临床价值，但受成本和可及性限制。我们评估了磁共振成像（MRI）衍生的合成[18F]FET PET的临床效用。回顾性分析了489例经组织学确诊的胶质瘤或脑转移患者。一个深度学习模型在总体队列和各亚组中由多模态MRI生成合成PET图像。将合成PET与参考PET进行比较：通过峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似性指数（SSIM）评估图像相似性；通过Pearson相关和Bland-Altman分析进行标准化摄取值比（SUVR）分析；并通过盲法阅片者评估，使用受试者工作特征分析和曲线下面积（AUC）评估胶质瘤分级以及高级别胶质瘤（HGG）与孤立性脑转移（SBM）的鉴别。合成PET在总体、胶质瘤和转移组中与参考PET显示出高度相似性（PSNR，34.7-35.5 dB；SSIM，0.90-0.96），且SUVR相关性较强（r = 0.77-0.93，所有P 0.05）。MRI衍生的合成[18F]FET PET可能增强胶质瘤分级和HGG-SBM鉴别，在无法获得FET PET时提供一种类PET的替代方案。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding is a common, potentially life-threatening condition, and capsule endoscopy (CE) is the principal investigation for suspected small-bowel bleeding after non-diagnostic upper endoscopy and colonoscopy. Because manual review of thousands of CE frames is labor-intensive, artificial intelligence (AI) has been proposed to automate bleeding detection. Methods: Following PRISMA 2020, this systematic review synthesizes 15 peer-reviewed journal studies (2020-2025) applying traditional machine learning, convolutional neural networks, transfer learning, attention-based or hybrid architectures, segmentation, or object detection to GI bleeding detection in CE. Methodological quality was appraised with an AI-adapted risk-of-bias framework informed by QUADAS-2 and PROBAST. Results: Frame-level classification accuracy ranged from 90.6% to 99.9% (median 98.5%; 13 studies), with the lowest values from evaluations closest to clinical practice; the segmentation and detection studies reported a mean intersection-over-union of 86.9% and an mAP@0.5 of 79.0%. Only two studies (13%) were at low risk of bias for validation strategy, none reported patient-level separation of training and test data, only four (27%) used clinical patient data, and none compared AI with conventional endoscopy or clinical outcomes. Conclusions: Current evidence demonstrates high performance on curated datasets but not yet generalizability or clinical readiness; patient-level, external, and prospective multicentre validation is required.

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis, heterogeneous disease phenotypes, and variable treatment responses remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising tool for improving PH management. AI-based models have demonstrated promising performance in screening, diagnosis, classification, risk stratification, and prognosis prediction using multimodal data such as electrocardiography, chest radiography, computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and electronic health records. Furthermore, AI may support individualized risk assessment, treatment-response prediction, early identification of right ventricular deterioration, and longitudinal remote monitoring. Emerging technologies, including explainable AI, federated learning, large language models, and digital twins, may further advance precision medicine in PH. Despite these advances, data quality, interpretability, privacy, and clinical implementation of AI remain challenges. This review summarizes current applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI in PH and discusses future directions for AI-assisted precision healthcare.

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Initial classification of skin lesions in the emergency department (ED) is difficult when dermatology consultations are limited. This study externally validated a deep learning (DL) algorithm for classifying three common ED skin lesions and explored whether algorithmic pre-classification was associated with changes in the classification performance of medical staff. Methods: A ResNet-50-based algorithm was developed using 6000 clinical images from 4815 patients. For external validation, 100 images from an independent institution were classified by the algorithm and nine medical staff members (three emergency medicine specialists, three residents, and three physician assistant [PA] nurses). Fifteen days later, the staff reclassified the same randomly reordered images with the algorithmic pre-classification provided. Results: In external validation, the algorithm showed an overall accuracy of 0.96 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.90-0.99), lesion-specific balanced accuracies of 0.95-0.96, and a macro-average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.98 (95% CI, 0.95-1.00). Unassisted, the three PA nurses differed significantly from the algorithm for urticaria and herpes zoster (all p < 0.01, McNemar's exact test). After receiving algorithmic assistance, all medical staff showed a balanced accuracy of 0.97 or higher for all three lesions. In the mixed-effects model, assistance was associated with higher odds of correct classification (odds ratio 25.9, 95% CI 11.7-57.2), and inter-rater agreement (Fleiss' κ) increased from 0.70 to 0.97. Conclusions: The algorithm demonstrated high classification performance on independent external validation, and algorithmic assistance was associated with improved classification performance, with the largest absolute gains among medical staff with lower unassisted accuracy. As these findings are exploratory, they should be confirmed in randomized prospective studies.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 【背景/目的】当皮肤科会诊有限时，急诊科（ED）对皮肤病变的初始分类较为困难。本研究对外部验证了一种用于分类三种常见ED皮肤病变的深度学习（DL）算法，并探讨算法预分类是否与医务人员分类性能的变化相关。【方法】使用来自4815例患者的6000张临床图像开发了一种基于ResNet-50的算法。为进行外部验证，来自一家独立机构的100张图像由该算法和九名医务人员（三名急诊医学专科医生、三名住院医师和三名医师助理[PA]护士）进行分类。十五天后，在提供算法预分类结果的情况下，这些医务人员对随机重新排序的同一批图像再次进行分类。【结果】在外部验证中，该算法的总体准确率为0.96（95%置信区间[CI]，0.90-0.99），病变特异性平衡准确率为0.95-0.96，受试者工作特征曲线下面积的宏平均值为0.98（95% CI，0.95-1.00）。在无辅助情况下，三名PA护士对荨麻疹和带状疱疹的分类与算法存在显著差异（均p < 0.01，McNemar精确检验）。在获得算法辅助后，所有医务人员对全部三种病变的平衡准确率均达到0.97或更高。在混合效应模型中，辅助与正确分类的更高比值比相关（比值比25.9，95% CI 11.7-57.2），评分者间一致性（Fleiss' κ）从0.70提高到0.97。【结论】该算法在独立外部验证中表现出高分类性能，算法辅助与分类性能改善相关，在无辅助准确率较低的医务人员中绝对增益最大。由于这些发现具有探索性，应在随机前瞻性研究中加以确认。

abstract: [Journal of critical care] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in critical care practice at a time when pharmacotherapeutic decisions are becoming more complex, data-intensive, and time-sensitive. For medical residents and fellows, this creates both educational opportunities and challenges, as AI may support learning but must not replace the development of independent clinical judgment. This perspective examines potential applications of AI in ICU pharmacotherapy training, including support for just-in-time learning, case-based practice, and bedside decision support. Key limitations and risks, such as misinformation, cognitive offloading, deskilling, privacy and data security, and bias in model outputs, are discussed along with possible mitigation strategies. Future training should prioritize building competencies related to AI-assisted clinical decision-making, including critical appraisal of AI-generated outputs and communication of AI-informed decisions within interprofessional teams. AI-supported pharmacotherapy training should be guided by clear boundaries around use and continued emphasis on building foundational pharmacotherapy knowledge, patient-specific reasoning, and clinical judgment.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can rapidly produce persuasive health information in the form of text, synthetic images, cloned voices and deepfake videos. It can also be used to create fictitious professional identities. This narrative review describes how synthetic claims, fabricated evidence and simulated identities are used to disguise misleading health information and give it the appearance of authenticity especially with regard to diagnostic safety and clinical practice. Literature identified through Web of Science and Scopus was synthesized across text image audio video and multimodal formats; current evidence indicates that generative AI can produce highly credible but inaccurate health content. Source authority, message framing and professional identity cues influence trust and verification behavior, while disease-specific evaluations show that high average accuracy may coexist with clinically important omissions, missed referrals, hallucinated findings and poor calibration. In medical imaging, errors may arise both from incorrect interpretation and from manipulation of the diagnostic evidence itself. Detection, evidence-based verification, provenance, literacy interventions, and governance provide complementary safeguards, although real-world and longitudinal evidence remains limited. Clinical evaluation should therefore consider task-specific performance, source authenticity, human oversight, and the consequences of individual errors alongside overall accuracy.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 生成式人工智能（AI）可以以文本、合成图像、克隆语音和深度伪造视频的形式快速产生有说服力的健康信息。它也可用于创建虚构的职业身份。本叙述性综述描述了合成主张、捏造证据和模拟身份如何被用来掩盖误导性健康信息并使其看起来真实，尤其是在诊断安全性和临床实践方面。通过 Web of Science 和 Scopus 识别的文献在文本、图像、音频、视频和多模态格式中进行了综合；当前证据表明，生成式 AI 可产生高度可信但不准确的健康内容。来源权威、信息框架和职业身份线索影响信任和验证行为，而疾病特异性评估显示，高平均准确率可能与临床上重要的遗漏、漏诊转诊、幻觉发现和校准不佳共存。在医学影像中，错误可能既源于错误解读，也源于对诊断证据本身的操纵。检测、循证验证、来源溯源、素养干预和治理提供了互补的保障措施，尽管真实世界和纵向证据仍然有限。因此，临床评估应同时考虑任务特定性能、来源真实性、人类监督以及个体错误的后果，而不仅仅是总体准确率。

abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formulas, developed through millennia of clinical practice, represent a rich legacy of approximately 100,000 documented prescriptions (99,584 named formula entries in the second edition of the Dictionary of Traditional Chinese Medicine Formulas), yet on average fewer than ten new TCM products were approved annually by China's NMPA from 2013 to 2024 (77 approvals in total). The experience-based screening paradigm is misaligned with the precision medicine framework demanded by metabolic syndrome (MetS), a multi-target disorder affecting an estimated 1.54 billion adults (95% CrI 1.35-1.76) in 2023. Although artificial intelligence (AI)-encompassing knowledge graphs (KGs), large language models (LLMs), and high-throughput experimentation-has been proposed as a solution, its actual readiness for TCM development remains unclear. This review critically examines KG, LLM, and high-throughput validation technologies enabling precision phytomedicine for MetS, providing a realistic roadmap for AI-driven TCM research and development. The three technology streams exhibit asymmetric readiness. At the stream level, knowledge-graph approaches span Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3-6, large language model approaches span TRL 1-5, and high-throughput validation platforms span TRL 3-5. LLM development is limited by three TCM-specific hallucination types that lack evaluation benchmarks. KG entity recognition is the most mature component, yet reasoning is hindered by the absence of negative data, missing dose-time dimensions, and unencoded monarch-minister-assistant-envoy hierarchies. High-throughput platforms are technically feasible but remain mismatched to MetS functional endpoints-tumor-derived organoid paradigms show limited direct transferability and would require substantial adaptation. Precision phytomedicine must follow a "foundations before algorithms" sequence: institutionalize negative data, build TCM-Hallu benchmarks, establish functional-endpoint evaluation, and develop AI-assisted regulatory review. Algorithmic advances will remain in an incomplete information space until knowledge infrastructure gaps are closed.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] 中医（TCM）方剂经数千年临床实践发展而来，代表了约100,000首有文献记载处方的丰富遗产（《中医方剂大辞典》（Dictionary of Traditional Chinese Medicine Formulas）第二版收录99,584个具名方剂条目），然而2013年至2024年，中国国家药品监督管理局（NMPA）平均每年批准的新中药产品不足十个（共77项批准）。这种基于经验的筛选范式与代谢综合征（MetS）所要求的精准医学框架不匹配；MetS是一种多靶点疾病，2023年估计影响15.4亿成人（95% CrI 1.35-1.76）。尽管人工智能（AI）——包括知识图谱（KGs）、大语言模型（LLMs）和高通量实验——已被提出作为解决方案，但其用于中药开发的实际成熟度仍不明确。本综述批判性审视了支持MetS精准植物药的KG、LLM和高通量验证技术，为AI驱动的中药研发提供现实路线图。这三类技术流呈现出不对称的成熟度。在技术流层面，知识图谱方法跨越技术成熟度（TRL）3-6，大语言模型方法跨越TRL 1-5，高通量验证平台跨越TRL 3-5。LLM开发受限于三类缺乏评估基准的中药特有幻觉。KG实体识别是最成熟的组成部分，但推理受到阴性数据缺失、剂量-时间维度缺失以及君臣佐使层级未编码的阻碍。高通量平台技术上可行，但仍与MetS功能终点不匹配——肿瘤来源类器官范式直接可迁移性有限，需要大幅调整。精准植物药必须遵循“先基础，后算法”的顺序：将阴性数据制度化、构建TCM-Hallu基准、建立功能性终点评估，并发展AI辅助监管审评。在知识基础设施缺口被弥合之前，算法进展将仍处于不完整信息空间中。

abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Wireless radar sensors can remotely detect vital signs. This study investigates the wireless monitoring of physiological signals induced by respiration and heartbeat to classify breathing states. Two 24 GHz radar sensors are used. Noise, harmonics, and intermodulation products affect the measured physiological signals and can make heartbeat identification and analysis challenging. Deep-learning techniques have recently been used to denoise and classify signals in wireless communications. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) have also been used for signal and image processing. Multilayer VAEs support sequential learning by optimizing generative-model parameters and reducing reconstruction error. This study investigates the separation of measured heartbeat and respiratory signals and the reduction in noise and the effects of limited random body movements using VAEs under controlled conditions. Two radars are positioned in front of and behind a human subject to record vital signals simultaneously. The separated and denoised heartbeat signals are input to a ResNet network to classify normal and fast breathing states. The proposed method achieves 99.7% accuracy on the reported experimental dataset.
zh_abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] 无线雷达传感器可远程检测生命体征。本研究探讨对呼吸和心跳引起的生理信号进行无线监测以分类呼吸状态。使用两个 24 GHz 雷达传感器。噪声、谐波和互调产物会影响所测生理信号，并可能使心跳识别和分析具有挑战性。深度学习技术近来已被用于无线通信中的信号去噪和分类。变分自编码器（variational autoencoders, VAE）也已用于信号和图像处理。多层 VAE 通过优化生成模型参数并降低重建误差来支持序列学习。本研究在受控条件下，探讨使用 VAE 分离所测心跳和呼吸信号、降低噪声以及减少有限随机身体运动的影响。两个雷达分别置于受试者前方和后方，以同时记录生命信号。分离并去噪后的心跳信号输入 ResNet 网络，以分类正常和快速呼吸状态。所提方法在报告的数据集上达到 99.7% 的准确率。

title: From Anatomy to Pathology: How Well Can AI Interpret Static Point-of-Care Ultrasound Images?

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Multimodal artificial intelligence may support point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) interpretation in emergency medicine, but its performance on static images and sensitivity to acquisition context remain uncertain. This study evaluated GPT-5.6 Sol and assessed whether probe-region information improves interpretation across view/plane, anatomy, and pathology domains. Methods: In this paired comparative in silico study, 92 educational ultrasound images from seven anatomical regions were assessed under standardized uninformed (image only) and informed (image plus probe-region code) prompting conditions. Two independent raters scored responses against textbook-based references in three domains: view/plane identification, anatomical structure identification, and pathological finding detection. Each domain was scored from 0 to 2. Disagreements were resolved by a third ultrasound expert, and fully correct responses were defined as domain scores of 2. The primary outcome was the total performance score (0-6). Secondary outcomes included domain-specific scores, fully correct response rates, and exploratory subgroup analyses. Wilcoxon signed-rank and McNemar tests assessed paired scores and fully correct rates, respectively. Results: Total performance was higher with informed prompting (median (interquartile range), 5 (4-6) versus 4 (2-5); p < 0.001). Interrater agreement was substantial to almost perfect across evaluation domains (quadratic-weighted κ = 0.750-1.000). Fully correct rates increased from 58.7% to 88.0% for view/plane identification and from 47.8% to 82.6% for anatomical structure identification (both p < 0.001). Pathological finding detection improved from 35.9% to 48.9% (p = 0.002). Among pathology-positive images, missed or incorrectly labeled pathology remained frequent (44.8%) despite informed prompting. Regional differences in total performance were significant only under uninformed prompting (p = 0.002). Conclusions: Probe-region information substantially improved view/plane and anatomical structure identification, but pathological finding detection remained comparatively weak. In static POCUS interpretation, improved anatomical recognition did not translate into reliable pathology detection. Persistent false-negative and false-positive errors do not support independent diagnostic use. Potential applications in POCUS education and anatomical labeling require further validation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目标】多模态人工智能可能支持急诊医学中的即时超声（POCUS）判读，但其在静态图像上的性能以及对采集环境的敏感性仍不确定。本研究评估了GPT-5.6 Sol，并评估探头区域信息是否能在视图/切面、解剖和病理领域改善判读。【方法】在这项配对比较的计算机模拟（in silico）研究中，来自七个解剖区域的92张教育用超声图像在标准化的无信息提示（仅图像）和有信息提示（图像加探头区域代码）条件下进行评估。两名独立评分者依据教科书参考对回答在三个领域进行评分：视图/切面识别、解剖结构识别和病理发现检测。每个领域评分0至2分。分歧由第三名超声专家解决，完全正确的回答定义为领域评分为2。主要结局为总性能评分（0-6）。次要结局包括各领域评分、完全正确回答率以及探索性亚组分析。分别使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和McNemar检验评估配对评分和完全正确率。【结果】有信息提示时总性能更高（中位数（四分位距），5（4-6）对4（2-5）；p < 0.001）。各评估领域的评分者间一致性为中等至几乎完美（二次加权κ = 0.750-1.000）。视图/切面识别的完全正确率从58.7%增至88.0%，解剖结构识别从47.8%增至82.6%（均p < 0.001）。病理发现检测从35.9%改善至48.9%（p = 0.002）。在病理阳性图像中，尽管有信息提示，漏诊或错误标注病理仍频繁（44.8%）。总性能的区域差异仅在无信息提示下显著（p = 0.002）。【结论】探头区域信息显著改善了视图/切面和解剖结构识别，但病理发现检测仍相对较弱。在静态POCUS判读中，解剖识别改善并未转化为可靠的病理检测。持续存在的假阴性和假阳性错误不支持独立诊断使用。在POCUS教育和解剖标注中的潜在应用需要进一步验证。

abstract: [Australian dental journal] A proportion of Australians encounter substantial unmet oral health needs despite eligibility for government-subsidised care. Yet, government dental services operate within a fragmented, mixed public-private system with limited capacity to support priority populations. The National Oral Health Plan (2015-2024) responds to this visible and measured need for priority. As the next National Oral Health Plan is developed, these priorities provide a timely basis to consider whether emerging technologies can support access and system performance without reproducing existing inequities. This narrative review aims to examine the potential uses, evidence for, challenges and implementation considerations of the use of Artificial Intelligence including machine learning, in Australian public-funded dental services, and to examine the implications for access, equity, governance, community co-design and workforce capability. The evidence is interpreted through a multidimensional framework for access to care, while retaining the National Oral Health Plan (2015-2024) as the policy context. Limited research conducted in Australian-based healthcare settings shows evidence for public dental system-level improvements for triage, risk stratification, service planning and workflow, but also identifies material concerns about opportunity cost, human oversight, non-representative data, algorithmic bias, cultural safety, Indigenous Data Sovereignty and clinician education. Artificial Intelligence and machine learning technologies may support more responsive public-funded dental services, but technical performance alone is not evidence of improved access or equitable care. Intentional, values-led implementation requires representative data, Indigenous-led governance, community co-design, transparent evaluation, human accountability and a digitally capable workforce.
zh_abstract: [Australian dental journal] 尽管符合政府补贴医疗资格，一部分澳大利亚人仍面临大量未满足的口腔健康需求。然而，政府牙科服务运行于碎片化的公私混合体系之中，支持优先人群的能力有限。《国家口腔健康计划（National Oral Health Plan，2015-2024）》回应了这种可见且已被测量的优先需求。随着下一版《国家口腔健康计划》的制定，这些优先事项为考虑新兴技术能否在不复制现有不公平的情况下支持可及性和系统绩效提供了及时依据。本叙述性综述旨在审视人工智能（AI，包括机器学习）在澳大利亚公共资助牙科服务中的潜在用途、证据、挑战和实施考量，并审视其对可及性、公平性、治理、社区共同设计（community co-design）和劳动力能力的影响。证据通过一个多维度的照护可及性框架加以解读，同时保留《国家口腔健康计划（2015-2024）》作为政策背景。在澳大利亚医疗环境中开展的有限研究显示，有证据支持公共牙科系统在分诊、风险分层、服务规划和工作流程方面取得改进，但也识别出对机会成本、人类监督、非代表性数据、算法偏倚、文化安全、原住民数据主权（Indigenous Data Sovereignty）和临床医生教育的重要担忧。人工智能和机器学习技术可能支持更具响应性的公共资助牙科服务，但仅凭技术性能并不能证明可及性改善或公平照护。有意识、以价值观为导向的实施需要代表性数据、由原住民主导的治理、社区共同设计、透明评估、人类问责以及具备数字能力的工作人员队伍。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Reliable classification of skin lesions is essential for early melanoma detection; however, substantial visual overlap among lesion types and pronounced class imbalance continue to limit the performance and reliability of existing automated systems. These challenges motivate the integration of complementary visual representations with clinical metadata to improve discrimination across lesion classes. Methods: This study introduces a calibrated multimodal ensemble learning framework for skin lesion classification. The proposed framework combines visual features extracted from Swin Transformer, EVA-02, and CoAtNet architectures with patient age and anatomical region information. A two-stage adaptive temperature scaling is applied to calibrate the predicted probabilities of the ensemble. Results: Experimental evaluation on the International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC 2019) dataset demonstrates strong classification performance, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.91 and a macro-AUC of 0.99. The framework further showed robust generalization on the official ISIC 2019 benchmark set, attaining a balanced accuracy of 0.65. The external validation on the PH2 dataset yielded a macro-F1 score of 0.93 and an ROC-AUC of 0.96. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate that combining heterogeneous visual representations, clinical metadata, and calibration-aware ensemble learning provides a robust and trustworthy solution for skin lesion classification and computer-aided dermatological diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】可靠的皮肤病变分类对于早期黑色素瘤检测至关重要；然而，病变类型之间显著的视觉重叠和明显的类别不平衡继续限制现有自动化系统的性能和可靠性。这些挑战促使将互补的视觉表示与临床元数据相结合，以提高跨病变类别的区分能力。【方法】本研究引入一种用于皮肤病变分类的校准多模态集成学习框架。所提出的框架将从Swin Transformer、EVA-02和CoAtNet架构提取的视觉特征与患者年龄和解剖区域信息相结合。应用两阶段自适应温度缩放来校准集成模型的预测概率。【结果】在国际皮肤成像协作组织（ISIC 2019）数据集上的实验评估显示出较强的分类性能，达到macro-F1分数0.91和macro-AUC 0.99。该框架在官方ISIC 2019基准集上进一步表现出稳健的泛化能力，达到平衡准确率0.65。在PH2数据集上的外部验证产生macro-F1分数0.93和ROC-AUC 0.96。【结论】这些发现表明，结合异质视觉表示、临床元数据和校准感知的集成学习为皮肤病变分类和计算机辅助皮肤科诊断提供了稳健且可信的解决方案。

abstract: [Annals of surgical oncology] Whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can identify publishable scientific work is untested. This study evaluated whether GPT-4.1 mini could distinguish Society of Surgical Oncology (SSO) posters that reached full-text publication using poster content alone and examined characteristics associated with conversion. This study retrospectively analyzed 597 posters from the 2022-2023 SSO Annual Meetings. Each poster was scored by GPT-4.1 on five research-quality domains during 30 runs at temperature zero. Discrimination was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Multivariable logistic regression tested whether the score added information beyond poster and investigator characteristics. Of 597 posters, 295 (49.4%) reached full-text publication. The composite score showed modest discrimination (AUC, 0.62; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57-0.66), with no evidence that performance differed across categories (interaction P = 0.90). Each 5-point increase in score was associated with higher adjusted odds of publication (odds ratio [OR], 1.45; 95% CI, 1.21-1.75), and adding the score to poster characteristics improved discrimination (ΔAUC, 0.05; 95% CI, 0.01-0.08). Design rigor, data quality, conclusion validity, and publication potential scores were associated with publication, but novelty was not. Multicenter status, first-author training status, and author sex were not significantly associated with publication. Lower adjusted odds for Hispanic first authors did not persist after multiplicity correction (OR, 0.35; 95% CI, 0.15-0.81). The GPT-4.1 mini scores modestly distinguished posters that reached publication and added information beyond poster characteristics. Multimodal large language models merit further study as instruments for examining and strengthening scholarly work rather than as arbiters of publishability.
zh_abstract: [Annals of surgical oncology] 多模态大语言模型（multimodal large language model, MLLM）能否识别可发表的科学工作尚待检验。本研究评估 GPT-4.1 mini 是否能仅利用壁报内容区分已实现全文发表的美国外科肿瘤学会（Society of Surgical Oncology, SSO）壁报，并考察与转化发表相关的特征。本研究回顾性分析了 2022—2023 年 SSO 年会上的 597 份壁报。每份壁报在温度为零的条件下由 GPT-4.1 运行 30 次，对五个研究质量维度进行评分。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUC）评估判别能力。多变量 logistic 回归检验评分是否在壁报和研究调查者特征之外提供额外信息。597 份壁报中，295 份（49.4%）实现全文发表。复合评分显示出中等判别能力（AUC，0.62；95% 置信区间[CI]，0.57-0.66），无证据表明各分类间表现存在差异（交互作用 P = 0.90）。评分每增加 5 分与更高的校正发表比值比相关（比值比[OR]，1.45；95% CI，1.21-1.75），将评分加入壁报特征后判别能力改善（ΔAUC，0.05；95% CI，0.01-0.08）。设计严谨性、数据质量、结论有效性和发表潜力评分与发表相关，但新颖性不相关。多中心状态、第一作者培训状态和作者性别与发表无显著相关。西班牙裔第一作者的校正比值比较低，但在多重性校正后不再持续（OR，0.35；95% CI，0.15-0.81）。GPT-4.1 mini 评分对达到发表的壁报具有中等区分能力，并在壁报特征之外提供额外信息。多模态大语言模型值得进一步研究，作为检查和强化学术工作的工具，而非可发表性的裁决者。

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Aim: To map recent artificial intelligence research in family medicine and primary care against an earlier 2015-2024 bibliometric baseline. Methods: Scopus was searched on 9 July 2026 for 2016-2026 publications. One researcher screened 3452 articles and reviews; 132 topical and 13 language exclusions left 3307 records. Manual title, DOI, and Scopus-identifier checks identified no duplicates. VOSviewer 1.6.21 and Biblioshiny (Bibliometrix 5.4.1; R 4.6.1) supported descriptive analysis and mapping. Results: Output increased from 531 in 2024 to 792 in 2025 (49.2%). The 2025 and partial 2026 component contained 1407 records (42.5%); 615 were dated 2026. The USA led publication and raw citation rankings (711 publications; 18,671 citations), while China preceded the United Kingdom in publication count. The Journal of Medical Internet Research (78 publications) and Scientific Reports (69) led the venues; seven top ten venues were shared with the earlier study. Language model terminology coexisted with later-positioned explainability, risk stratification, and diagnostic accuracy terms. Conclusions: This updated map quantifies post-2024 activity and identifies continuity and corpus-dependent differences in geography, dissemination, and evaluation-related vocabulary. Single-database and English language coverage, single-researcher screening, unadjusted citations, and incomplete 2026 coverage limit inference. The findings describe research activity, not clinical adoption, safety, effectiveness, or causality.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 【目的】将近期家庭医学和初级保健中的人工智能研究映射到较早的 2015-2024 年文献计量基线。【方法】于 2026 年 7 月 9 日检索 Scopus，获取 2016-2026 年出版物。一名研究者筛选了 3452 篇文章和综述；排除 132 篇主题不符和 13 篇语言不符后，剩余 3307 条记录。人工标题、DOI 和 Scopus 标识符检查未发现重复。VOSviewer 1.6.21 和 Biblioshiny（Bibliometrix 5.4.1；R 4.6.1）支持描述性分析和映射。【结果】产出从 2024 年的 531 篇增加到 2025 年的 792 篇（49.2%）。2025 年和部分 2026 年组成部分包含 1407 条记录（42.5%）；其中 615 条日期为 2026 年。美国在发表量和原始引用排名中领先（711 篇出版物；18,671 次引用），而中国在发表数量上超过英国。《Journal of Medical Internet Research》（78 篇出版物）和《Scientific Reports》（69 篇）在发表场所中领先；排名前十的场所中有七个与较早研究相同。语言模型术语与位置更靠后的可解释性、风险分层和诊断准确性术语共存。【结论】这一更新图谱量化了 2024 年后的活动，并识别了地理、传播和评估相关词汇方面的连续性和语料库依赖性差异。单一数据库和英语语言覆盖、单研究者筛选、未调整引用以及 2026 年覆盖不完整限制了推断。这些发现描述的是研究活动，而不是临床采用、安全性、有效性或因果关系。

abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Ageing is a multidimensional biological process characterised by interacting molecular, physiological, functional, and environmental changes that chronological age alone cannot adequately represent. The rapid development of epigenetic clocks, proteomic and metabolomic signatures, imaging-derived biomarkers, wearable sensors, and digital phenotypes has created an increasingly rich but fragmented landscape of aging biomarkers. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a potential integrative framework that can combine these heterogeneous data streams and convert them into multidimensional estimates of biological age, health risk, functional reserve, and potentially treatment response. Recent studies demonstrate that molecular and clinical information can be integrated into composite aging measures, while independent work shows that wearable movement data, retinal imaging, and speech characteristics can provide non-invasive digital representations of aging-related phenotypes. The emerging concept of multimodal aging clocks extends these approaches by integrating physiological, clinical, imaging, and molecular measurements into a common representation of biological aging.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 衰老是一个多维生物学过程，其特征是分子、生理、功能和环境变化相互作用，仅靠实际年龄无法充分表征。表观遗传时钟、蛋白质组学和代谢组学特征、影像衍生生物标志物、可穿戴传感器和数字表型的快速发展，已形成一个日益丰富但碎片化的衰老生物标志物格局。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）提供了一个潜在整合框架，可结合这些异质性数据流，并将其转化为对生物学年龄、健康风险、功能储备以及潜在治疗反应的多维估计。近期研究表明，分子和临床信息可整合为复合衰老指标，而独立工作显示，可穿戴运动数据、视网膜成像和语音特征可提供衰老相关表型的非侵入性数字表征。新兴的多模态衰老时钟概念通过将生理、临床、影像和分子测量整合为生物学衰老的共同表征，扩展了这些方法。

abstract: [Medical science educator] The pilot comparability study by Josan and colleagues comparing GPT-4-generated and expert-written OSCE standardized patient scripts offers timely insights for medical education. This letter highlights three considerations. First, the "AI-only" arm was not human-free but reflected an expert-supervised iterative loop, suggesting that the key contrast lies in workflow design rather than authorship. Second, the AI+human scripts scored highest in clinical accuracy yet lowest in realism, consistent with evidence that combined human-AI workflows can underperform the stronger party alone, particularly when humans act as final arbiters rather than co-producers. Third, large language models may be better suited to knowledge-intensive, protocol-driven OSCE cases than to communication-heavy scenarios. Future studies should distinguish subject-matter from task-specific editor expertise and develop a case typology to guide appropriate AI deployment.
zh_abstract: [Medical science educator] Josan及其同事开展的初步可比性研究比较了GPT-4生成与专家撰写的OSCE标准化病人脚本，为医学教育提供了及时见解。本函件强调三点考虑。第一，“仅AI”组并非无人参与，而是反映了专家监督下的迭代循环，提示关键差异在于工作流程设计而非作者身份。第二，AI+人工脚本在临床准确性上得分最高，但在真实性上得分最低，这与以下证据一致：人-AI联合工作流程可能不如单独由更强一方表现，尤其是当人类作为最终仲裁者而非共同生产者时。第三，大型语言模型可能更适合知识密集型、方案驱动的OSCE病例，而非沟通密集型场景。未来研究应区分学科专业知识与任务特定编辑专长，并开发病例类型学以指导适当的AI部署。
